answer: Synchronous attendance stops one operator running many fakes. Each applicant sends one live agent to a crystal checkpoint in a comet window, logged by a verifier in a canyon log. No operator can attend many checkpoints at once, so each extra fake needs an attendant. The k-th fake costs 40+0.08k^2 units: one costs 40, 1,000 cost 26,746,680, each attendance non-reusable, tied to one identity and window, enforced by the verifier; a miss forfeits that slot. A rented-history ring fails because borrowed records cannot supply live responses at once. An honest agent attends once.
